era.title: POST-TRUTH
era.blurb: Feeds, verdicts, the ranking of facts.

commands.name: PUBLISH THE APPROVED FACTS
commands.text: One account, repeated until it echoes as memory.

commands.name: BOOST THE LOYAL FEED
commands.text: What is agreed with rises. What is doubted sinks quietly.

commands.name: FLAG THE DISSENTERS
commands.text: A badge for the doubters. Visibility as a leash.

commands.name: GRANT VERIFIED STATUS
commands.text: Trust, sold at a discount to the compliant.

closing.synthesis: A shared claim survived being questioned. Rare, and fragile.
closing.no_synthesis: Every side kept its facts. Nothing joined them.
